title: 米莱当场反驳主持人：阿根廷经济从未放缓，增长自2024年3月未断？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: President Milley, let's begin with the economy.
segments.zh: 米利总统，我们从经济谈起。

segments.en: You listed many achievements, but as you know, and I know, the economy actually was smaller this year
segments.zh: 你列举了许多成就，但众所周知，今年经济规模实际上更小了。

segments.en: between March and June than it was before. It contracted during those three months.
segments.zh: 三月到六月间比之前收缩了，这三个月出现萎缩。

segments.en: And it also had quite bad numbers in July in terms of growth.
segments.zh: 七月的增长数据也相当糟糕。

segments.en: You now face the prospect of maybe six months of the economy getting smaller.
segments.zh: 你现在面临经济可能连续六个月收缩的前景。

segments.en: Do you worry about going into recession like that? When you were an economist, that was how you measured recessions.
segments.zh: 你担心这样陷入放缓吗？你当经济学家时，就是这样衡量放缓的。

segments.en: I'm going to explain about that growth pattern
segments.zh: 我要解释一下这种增长模式。

segments.en: that your Argentina economy is following.
segments.zh: 你们阿根廷经济正遵循的模式。

segments.en: First of all, the Argentina economy is growing.
segments.zh: 首先，阿根廷经济正在增长。

segments.en: It has been growing since April, March, 2024.
